NAME: Maneuver Planning Plugin
DESCRIPTION: Orbital maneuver planning over the $MPL (maneuver plan) standard, one $MPL request in and the answered $MPL out: Hohmann, bi-elliptic, plane change, combined, phasing (by angle or from a target's orbit), Lambert, CAM, ROE state transition, waypoint missions, approach corridors, closed-loop rendezvous and orbit geometry.
